card.name: Nouns after quantity or size words
card.fires_on: A noun that follows a number or amount word in general web text about reports, research or funding, such as pages, million, amounts, book or advances. It sits where a measured or counted thing is named.

modes.label: Counts of pages or money
modes.description: A unit noun right after a figure, such as page count or dollars.

modes.label: Nouns after quantity adjectives
modes.description: A noun after words like increasing, considerable or recent, in research or policy writing.
modes.example: spent increasing<< amounts>> of taxpayer money on Missouri’s public schools

modes.label: Publication-type words
modes.description: Part of a word for a printed resource, such as toolkits or publications.

card.writes: The output tokens are mostly Chinese words and odd fragments, so there is no clear effect on English text.
